create.name: Sarina Stone
create.bio:
Sarina Stone is a qigong and meditation teacher based in Minneapolis who works in the Taoist tradition of Master Mantak Chia. She studied with him for about ten years and taught at Tao Garden, his retreat centre in northern Thailand, before building her own teaching practice in the United States. Alongside qigong she teaches Chi Nei Tsang, the Taoist abdominal massage, and has given intuitive readings and private guidance to long-term clients for many years.

Her teaching centres on the classic Taoist inner alchemy practices, such as the Inner Smile and the Microcosmic Orbit, which she presents as ways of noticing emotions, moving energy through the body and settling the mind. She ties these to a playful interest in thought, intention and manifestation, and runs online lessons, downloadable guided practices, certification courses and consultations, with some material in French and a set of songs and practices for children. She is also the author of the Tequila series, light-hearted books that bring Taoist ideas to dating, partnership and intimacy, and she has a few recordings on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Private Consultation
courses.description: A 30- or 60-minute one-to-one session to ask about your qigong or Chi Nei Tsang practice, or about direction in life more generally. She may suggest a practice or guide you through one during the session.

courses.title: Inner Smile Qigong Meditation Instruction Video Download
courses.description: A video lesson in the Inner Smile, the Taoist practice of directing a warm, smiling attention inward to the organs and the emotions linked with them. It is the first of three classic practices she teaches as a set.

courses.title: MicroCosmic Orbit QiGong Meditation Instruction Video Download
courses.description: A video lesson that maps the points of the Microcosmic Orbit and shows how to circulate and store energy along it, the foundation practice of Taoist inner alchemy.

courses.title: Tao of Manifestation CO-CREATION MADE EASY Guided Meditation MP3
courses.description: A guided audio meditation for daily use that works with intention and visualisation, inviting you to picture what you want to create in work, relationships and everyday life.

free_resources.title: Sarina Stone on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A small set of her Taoist qigong recordings, including a guided meditation and a short video practice, free to play.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 740 (profile, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram @the_taolady 4,311 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026; linked from her site); YouTube @TaoLady 1.04k (channel page); Facebook TaoLady not readable without login → ~6.1k total → local_hero
flags: Her whole brand is framed as Medical QiGong and natural health (her Insight Timer bio calls her a medical Chi Kung instructor, the menu has a Pain Relief page); all medical, detox and condition-led items are out and the bio avoids that wording. Only four paid items survive, so a human may judge the listing too thin or too medical overall.
No usable videos: every non-medical video on her YouTube channel is under two minutes (mostly promos), and the longer ones are medical-framed.
Her Tequila series books exist (Open Library ISBN-10 0982638426 and 0982638450) but amazon.com /dp/ pages returned 500 to curl and WebFetch, so no books listed.
A second Instagram, @sarinastone (464 followers), was not counted because her site links @the_taolady.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; the bio check relied mainly on her own site pages.
Minneapolis base from Insight Timer; no in-person class schedule or address found, so availability is worldwide.
Insight Timer profile photo (side view with a watermark) not used; site headshot and YouTube avatar look like the same woman.
